title: The periodic table by block
caption: The block is the sub-shell that the last electron enters: s for groups 1 and 2 (and helium), p for groups 13 to 18, d for the transition series, f for the lanthanides and actinides.
alt: The periodic table coloured by block: s block on the left, d block in the middle, p block on the right, f block below.
description: Groups 1 and 2, with hydrogen and helium: the s block.
The two rows below the table, lanthanides and actinides: the f block.
